Dataset.title: Dataset
Dataset.description: An uploaded or sample Excel dataset summary and analytical profile synchronized to the cloud.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the dataset owner.

rowCount.description: Total number of data rows in the spreadsheet.

columnCount.description: Total number of columns in the spreadsheet.

columnsSummary.description: Structured statistical profile of columns, distributions, and sample rows.

trendsSummary.description: Executive natural-language trend analysis extracted from the dataset.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the dataset was first synced.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the dataset was last updated.

QueryLog.title: QueryLog
QueryLog.description: A natural-language question and analytical response stored under a dataset.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who created the query.

question.description: Natural language question asked by the user.

answer.description: Detailed analytical answer generated from the dataset.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the query was logged.

/datasets/{datasetId}.description: User-owned synchronized Excel dataset profiles and trend summaries.

/datasets/{datasetId}/queries/{queryId}.description: Subcollection of natural-language Q&A logs belonging to a specific dataset.
